actions.how: Call (555) 010-7788 to request an expedited appeal if your back pain is urgent.
actions.step: Call (555) 010-7790 within 14 calendar days to ask for a peer-to-peer discussion with the medical director.

actions.how: Mail your standard appeal to Northstar Health Plan - Appeals Unit, P.O. Box 5551, Cedar Falls, IA 50000, or fax to (555) 010-7799.
actions.step: Include your Member ID and Reference Number with your appeal.

actions.how: Call Member Services at (555) 010-7700 (TTY 711), Monday through Friday, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. for questions.
actions.step: Call (555) 010-7700 to get free language assistance services.

contacts.why: Request an expedited appeal if your condition is urgent.
Request a peer-to-peer discussion with the medical director.
Ask questions about the notice or get free language assistance.

deadlines.quote: Your appeal must be received within 180 calendar days from the date of this notice.
deadlines.rule: within 180 calendar days from the date of this notice
deadlines.what: Submit your standard appeal or expedited appeal request.

deadlines.quote: Your provider may also request a peer-to-peer discussion with our medical director by calling (555) 010-7790 within 14 calendar days of this notice.
deadlines.rule: within 14 calendar days of this notice
deadlines.what: Request a peer-to-peer discussion with the medical director.

questions_to_ask: What documents or records should I include to help my appeal be approved?
What is the exact process for requesting an expedited appeal if my back pain is urgent?
Will I receive free copies of the documents used in this coverage decision?
result.reply_draft:
Dear Northstar Health Plan Appeals Unit,

My Member ID is [Member ID]. My Reference Number is [Reference Number]. I am Maria L. Example. My back pain is getting worse, and I want to appeal this coverage denial for my MRI, lumbar spine without contrast (CPT 72148). I would like to request an appeal of this decision. Please let me know the steps I need to follow to submit my appeal.

Sincerely,
[Your name]
[Your contact information]
result.reply_subject: Appeal request - MRI, lumbar spine without contrast (CPT 72148)
rights: You have the right to request an internal appeal of this decision.
You may submit written comments, documents, records, and other information relating to your claim.
You may request, free of charge, copies of all documents relevant to this decision, including the medical policy cited.
If your internal appeal is denied, you may have the right to an independent external review.
result.sender: Northstar Health Plan Utilization Management Department
summary: Northstar Health Plan said no to your MRI.
Your MRI was for your lumbar spine without contrast (CPT 72148).
They did not give you the needed therapy.
They did not give you the needed red-flag notes.
You must send your appeal in 180 calendar days.
You can call for a fast appeal.
Call if your back pain is urgent.
You can ask for a peer-to-peer talk in 14 calendar days.
You can send a normal appeal by mail or fax.
You can ask for free copies of the documents.
summary_first_draft: Northstar Health Plan denied coverage for your MRI, lumbar spine without contrast (CPT 72148) because the required conservative therapy and red-flag documentation were not met.
You have the right to appeal this decision, and you must submit your appeal within 180 calendar days of this notice.
You can request an expedited appeal by phone if your back pain is urgent, or ask for a peer-to-peer discussion within 14 calendar days.
You can submit a standard appeal by mail or fax, and you can ask for free copies of the relevant documents.
